cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Failure Reveals the Mission
cards.instruction: Use each failed step to reveal a different goal the plan was secretly pursuing, then act immediately on that new mission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Base rejected our ship's report. We were secretly sent to receive; I'll switch channels.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only static. I need a forecast before my watch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take my forecast sheet. That's applause. Our real mission is entertainment: 'Rain on deck, scrub, scrub, scrub!'

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The connection's dropped. You've lost your audience.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then this was rejection training. Take the microphone; refuse me a second verse.
